items.question: Trong câu "Most problems can be solved in many ways.", từ "solve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most problems can be solved in many ways.", what does "solve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: solve /sɒlv/ (động từ): giải quyết. "Solve a problem" = giải một bài toán; "can be solved in many ways" = có thể giải bằng nhiều cách.
items.explanationEn: solve /sɒlv/ (verb): to find an answer to. "Solve a problem" is the standard collocation; "can be solved in many ways" means there are several possible solutions.

items.question: Trong câu "Less memory — less extra storage while running (space complexity).", từ "storage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Less memory — less extra storage while running (space complexity).", what does "storage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: storage /ˈstɔː.rɪdʒ/ (danh từ): chỗ lưu trữ dữ liệu. "Extra storage" = bộ nhớ lưu trữ thêm mà thuật toán cần; một nghĩa khác của storage là kho chứa hàng hóa.
items.explanationEn: storage /ˈstɔː.rɪdʒ/ (noun): space for keeping data. "Extra storage" is the additional memory an algorithm needs; in everyday use storage can also mean a place for keeping goods.

items.question: Trong câu "More readable — easier for humans to maintain.", từ "readable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More readable — easier for humans to maintain.", what does "readable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: readable /ˈriː.də.bəl/ (tính từ): dễ đọc, dễ hiểu. "Readable code" = mã dễ đọc; khả năng đọc hiểu gọi là "readability".
items.explanationEn: readable /ˈriː.də.bəl/ (adjective): easy to read and follow. "Readable code" is code that is easy to read; the noun is "readability".

items.question: Trong câu "More readable — easier for humans to maintain.", từ "maintain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More readable — easier for humans to maintain.", what does "maintain" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to keep in good working order
items.explanation: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (động từ): bảo trì, duy trì. "Maintain code" = bảo trì mã (sửa, cập nhật theo thời gian); nghĩa khác "maintain that..." = khẳng định rằng.
items.explanationEn: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep in good working order. "Maintain code" means keeping it working and up to date over time; "maintain that..." is a different sense meaning to claim.

items.question: Trong câu "This topic focuses on the first two.", từ "focus on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This topic focuses on the first two.", what does "focus on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: focus on /ˈfəʊ.kəs ɒn/ (cụm từ): tập trung vào. "Focus on something" = tập trung vào điều gì; danh từ: "the focus of this topic".
items.explanationEn: focus on /ˈfəʊ.kəs ɒn/ (phrase): to concentrate on. "Focus on something" means to give it most of your attention; noun form: "the focus of this topic".

items.question: Trong câu "Big O gives us a precise, shared vocabulary for how code performs.", từ "precise" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Big O gives us a precise, shared vocabulary for how code performs.", what does "precise" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: precise /prɪˈsaɪs/ (tính từ): chính xác, rõ ràng. "Precise" = chính xác, không mơ hồ; trạng từ "precisely" (một cách chính xác).
items.explanationEn: precise /prɪˈsaɪs/ (adjective): exact and clear. "Precise" means exact and leaving no doubt; the adverb is "precisely".

items.question: Trong câu "Discuss trade-offs between approaches objectively.", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Discuss trade-offs between approaches objectively.", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "Trade-off between A and B" = sự đánh đổi giữa A và B, ví dụ được thời gian nhưng mất bộ nhớ.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (noun): a balance between two gains. A "trade-off between A and B" means gaining one thing by giving up another, e.g. faster time for more memory.

items.question: Trong câu "Discuss trade-offs between approaches objectively.", từ "objectively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Discuss trade-offs between approaches objectively.", what does "objectively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: objectively /əbˈdʒek.tɪv.li/ (trạng từ): một cách khách quan. "Objectively" = khách quan, dựa trên dữ kiện; trái nghĩa "subjectively" (chủ quan).
items.explanationEn: objectively /əbˈdʒek.tɪv.li/ (adverb): based on facts, not feelings. "Objectively" means based on facts rather than opinion; the opposite is "subjectively".

items.question: Trong câu "Find the part of a slow program that is actually the bottleneck.", từ "bottleneck" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Find the part of a slow program that is actually the bottleneck.", what does "bottleneck" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bottleneck /ˈbɒt.əl.nek/ (danh từ): điểm nghẽn. "Bottleneck" = điểm nghẽn làm chậm cả hệ thống; nghĩa đen là cổ chai.
items.explanationEn: bottleneck /ˈbɒt.əl.nek/ (noun): the part that slows everything. A "bottleneck" is the part that limits overall speed; literally it is the narrow neck of a bottle.

items.question: Trong câu "This is useful for profiling real code, but it is a poor way to compare algorithms:", từ "profile" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is useful for profiling real code, but it is a poor way to compare algorithms:", what does "profile" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: profile /ˈprəʊ.faɪl/ (động từ): đo hiệu năng chạy. "Profile code" = đo xem mã tốn thời gian/bộ nhớ ở đâu; công cụ gọi là "profiler". Danh từ "profile" còn nghĩa là hồ sơ.
items.explanationEn: profile /ˈprəʊ.faɪl/ (verb): to measure runtime performance. "Profile code" means measuring where it spends time or memory, using a "profiler"; the noun "profile" can also mean a personal record.

items.question: Trong câu "Different machines record different times (CPU, memory, other load).", từ "load" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Different machines record different times (CPU, memory, other load).", what does "load" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the amount of work being run
items.explanation: load /ləʊd/ (danh từ): lượng công việc đang chạy. "Load" ở đây = tải, lượng việc máy đang xử lý; nghĩa khác là hàng hóa chở trên xe.
items.explanationEn: load /ləʊd/ (noun): the amount of work being run. Here "load" is the amount of work a machine is handling; it can also mean goods carried by a vehicle.

items.question: Trong câu "We want a measure that depends only on the algorithm, not on the hardware.", từ "depend on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "We want a measure that depends only on the algorithm, not on the hardware.", what does "depend on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: depend on /dɪˈpend ɒn/ (cụm từ): phụ thuộc vào. "Depend on X" = phụ thuộc vào X; "depending on" = tùy thuộc vào.
items.explanationEn: depend on /dɪˈpend ɒn/ (phrase): to be decided by. "Depend on X" means to be decided or affected by X; "depending on" means according to.

items.question: Trong câu "What matters is the trend: the work grows proportionally with n.", từ "trend" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What matters is the trend: the work grows proportionally with n.", what does "trend" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trend /trend/ (danh từ): xu hướng. "The trend" = xu hướng chung khi n tăng; nghĩa khác là mốt, trào lưu ("a fashion trend").
items.explanationEn: trend /trend/ (noun): a general direction of change. "The trend" is the general direction of change as n grows; it can also mean a fashion, as in "a fashion trend".

items.question: Trong câu "What matters is the trend: the work grows proportionally with n.", từ "proportionally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What matters is the trend: the work grows proportionally with n.", what does "proportionally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: proportionally /prəˈpɔː.ʃən.əl.i/ (trạng từ): theo tỉ lệ thuận. "Grow proportionally with n" = tăng theo tỉ lệ thuận với n (n gấp đôi thì công việc gấp đôi).
items.explanationEn: proportionally /prəˈpɔː.ʃən.əl.i/ (adverb): at the same rate. "Grow proportionally with n" means increasing at the same rate as n: double n, double the work.

items.question: Trong câu "Double n and the work roughly doubles.", từ "roughly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Double n and the work roughly doubles.", what does "roughly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: roughly /ˈrʌf.li/ (trạng từ): khoảng, xấp xỉ. "Roughly" = khoảng, xấp xỉ (= approximately); nghĩa khác là thô bạo ("treat roughly").
items.explanationEn: roughly /ˈrʌf.li/ (adverb): approximately. "Roughly" means approximately; it can also mean in a violent way, as in "treat someone roughly".

items.question: Trong câu "Big O formalises this fuzzy counting.", từ "formalise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Big O formalises this fuzzy counting.", what does "formalise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: formalise /ˈfɔː.məl.aɪz/ (động từ): chính thức hóa. "Formalise" (Mỹ: formalize) = chính thức hóa, biến ý tưởng mơ hồ thành định nghĩa chặt chẽ.
items.explanationEn: formalise /ˈfɔː.məl.aɪz/ (verb): to make exact and official. "Formalise" (US: formalize) means turning a loose idea into an exact, rigorous definition.

items.question: Trong câu "Big O formalises this fuzzy counting.", từ "fuzzy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Big O formalises this fuzzy counting.", what does "fuzzy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fuzzy /ˈfʌz.i/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, không chính xác. "Fuzzy" ở đây = mơ hồ, thiếu chính xác; nghĩa đen là có lông tơ (một con gấu bông fuzzy).
items.explanationEn: fuzzy /ˈfʌz.i/ (adjective): vague, not exact. Here "fuzzy" means vague or imprecise; literally it means covered in soft hair, like a fuzzy toy.

items.question: Trong câu "It describes how the running time (or memory) grows as the input grows, ignoring details.", từ "ignore" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It describes how the running time (or memory) grows as the input grows, ignoring details.", what does "ignore" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ignore /ɪɡˈnɔːr/ (động từ): bỏ qua. "Ignore details" = bỏ qua chi tiết; hay gặp trong tài liệu: "this value is ignored".
items.explanationEn: ignore /ɪɡˈnɔːr/ (verb): to leave out. "Ignore details" means to leave them out on purpose; docs often say "this value is ignored".

items.question: Trong câu "An algorithm is O(f(n)) if the number of simple operations is eventually less than a constant times f(n) as n increases.", từ "eventually" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An algorithm is O(f(n)) if the number of simple operations is eventually less than a constant times f(n) as n increases.", what does "eventually" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: in the end, after a while
items.explanation: eventually /ɪˈven.tʃu.əl.i/ (trạng từ): cuối cùng, về sau. "Eventually" = cuối cùng, sau một thời gian (không phải "có lẽ" như eventual trong một số tiếng châu Âu).
items.explanationEn: eventually /ɪˈven.tʃu.əl.i/ (adverb): in the end, after a while. "Eventually" means in the end or after some time; it is a false friend for "possibly" in some languages.

items.question: Trong câu "An algorithm is O(f(n)) if the number of simple operations is eventually less than a constant times f(n) as n increases.", từ "constant" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An algorithm is O(f(n)) if the number of simple operations is eventually less than a constant times f(n) as n increases.", what does "constant" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constant /ˈkɒn.stənt/ (danh từ): hằng số. "A constant" (danh từ) = hằng số; tính từ "constant" = không đổi, như "constant time".
items.explanationEn: constant /ˈkɒn.stənt/ (noun): a fixed number. "A constant" (noun) is a fixed number; as an adjective it means unchanging, as in "constant time".

items.question: Trong câu "Big O is an upper bound.", từ "upper bound" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Big O is an upper bound.", what does "upper bound" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: upper bound /ˈʌp.ər baʊnd/ (cụm từ): cận trên. "Upper bound" = cận trên (giá trị không vượt quá); đối lại "lower bound" = cận dưới.
items.explanationEn: upper bound /ˈʌp.ər baʊnd/ (phrase): an upper limit. An "upper bound" is a limit that a value never exceeds; the opposite is a "lower bound".

items.question: Trong câu "Technically a linear algorithm is also O(n²), but we always quote the tightest bound, because that is the useful one.", từ "tight" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Technically a linear algorithm is also O(n²), but we always quote the tightest bound, because that is the useful one.", what does "tight" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: tight /taɪt/ (tính từ): sát nhất, chặt nhất. "Tight bound" = cận chặt, sát với thực tế nhất; nghĩa thường ngày là chật, bó sát (quần áo).
items.explanationEn: tight /taɪt/ (adjective): closest to the real value. A "tight bound" is the one closest to the real growth; in everyday use tight means fitting closely, like clothes.

items.question: Trong câu "Technically a linear algorithm is also O(n²), but we always quote the tightest bound, because that is the useful one.", từ "technically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Technically a linear algorithm is also O(n²), but we always quote the tightest bound, because that is the useful one.", what does "technically" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: technically /ˈtek.nɪ.kəl.i/ (trạng từ): xét theo lý thuyết. "Technically" = xét theo đúng định nghĩa, về lý thuyết thì đúng nhưng ít dùng trong thực tế.
items.explanationEn: technically /ˈtek.nɪ.kəl.i/ (adverb): strictly speaking. "Technically" means strictly according to the rules or definition, even if not how people usually speak.

items.question: Trong câu "Related notations exist: Ω (Omega) is a lower bound and Θ (Theta) is a tight bound (both upper and lower).", từ "notation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Related notations exist: Ω (Omega) is a lower bound and Θ (Theta) is a tight bound (both upper and lower).", what does "notation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: notation /nəʊˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): ký hiệu. "Notation" = hệ ký hiệu; "Big O notation" = ký hiệu Big O.
items.explanationEn: notation /nəʊˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a system of symbols. "Notation" is a system of symbols; "Big O notation" is the standard name.

items.question: Trong câu "Because Big O only cares about growth for large n, two rules follow directly from the definition.", từ "directly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because Big O only cares about growth for large n, two rules follow directly from the definition.", what does "directly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: directly /daɪˈrekt.li/ (trạng từ): trực tiếp. "Follow directly from X" = suy ra trực tiếp từ X, không cần bước trung gian.
items.explanationEn: directly /daɪˈrekt.li/ (adverb): with no step between. "Follow directly from X" means it comes straight from X with no extra steps.

items.question: Trong câu "Smaller terms don't matter — keep only the fastest-growing term:", từ "term" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Smaller terms don't matter — keep only the fastest-growing term:", what does "term" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: term /tɜːm/ (danh từ): số hạng (trong biểu thức). "Term" trong toán = số hạng, như 5n trong n² + 5n; các nghĩa khác: thuật ngữ, học kỳ, điều khoản.
items.explanationEn: term /tɜːm/ (noun): a part of a sum. In maths a "term" is one part of a sum, like 5n in n² + 5n; it can also mean a word, a school period or a contract condition.

items.question: Trong câu "At n = 1,000,000, n² is 10¹² while 5n is 5 × 10⁶ — the small term is noise.", từ "noise" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "At n = 1,000,000, n² is 10¹² while 5n is 5 × 10⁶ — the small term is noise.", what does "noise" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: noise /nɔɪz/ (danh từ): phần không đáng kể. "Is noise" = chỉ là nhiễu, không đáng kể so với phần chính; nghĩa gốc là tiếng ồn.
items.explanationEn: noise /nɔɪz/ (noun): something too small to matter. Saying something "is noise" means it is too small to matter next to the main part; the basic sense is a loud sound.

items.question: Trong câu "This rule is a frequent interview trap:", từ "frequent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This rule is a frequent interview trap:", what does "frequent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: frequent /ˈfriː.kwənt/ (tính từ): thường gặp. "Frequent" = thường xuyên; trạng từ "frequently", danh từ "frequency" (tần suất).
items.explanationEn: frequent /ˈfriː.kwənt/ (adjective): happening often. "Frequent" means happening often; the adverb is "frequently" and the noun is "frequency".

items.question: Trong câu "This rule is a frequent interview trap:", từ "trap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This rule is a frequent interview trap:", what does "trap" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a point where people often fail
items.explanation: trap /træp/ (danh từ): cái bẫy, chỗ dễ sai. "Interview trap" = câu bẫy trong phỏng vấn, dễ khiến người ta trả lời sai; nghĩa đen là bẫy bắt thú.
items.explanationEn: trap /træp/ (noun): a point where people often fail. An "interview trap" is a point where candidates often answer wrongly; literally a trap catches animals.

items.question: Trong câu "These shorthands work for most everyday code:", từ "shorthand" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These shorthands work for most everyday code:", what does "shorthand" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a quick rule or short form
items.explanation: shorthand /ˈʃɔːt.hænd/ (danh từ): cách viết/quy tắc tắt. "Shorthand" ở đây = quy tắc nhanh, cách nói tắt; nghĩa gốc là chữ tốc ký.
items.explanationEn: shorthand /ˈʃɔːt.hænd/ (noun): a quick rule or short form. Here "shorthand" means a quick rule or short form; originally it is a system of fast handwriting.

items.question: Trong câu "These shorthands work for most everyday code:", từ "everyday" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These shorthands work for most everyday code:", what does "everyday" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: everyday /ˈev.ri.deɪ/ (tính từ): hằng ngày, thông thường. "Everyday" (tính từ, viết liền) = thông thường; khác "every day" (hai từ) = mỗi ngày.
items.explanationEn: everyday /ˈev.ri.deɪ/ (adjective): ordinary, common. "Everyday" (one word, adjective) means ordinary; "every day" (two words) means each day.

items.question: Trong câu "Arithmetic operations are constant.", từ "arithmetic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Arithmetic operations are constant.", what does "arithmetic" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: relating to basic maths with numbers
items.explanation: arithmetic /ˌær.ɪθˈmet.ɪk/ (tính từ): số học. "Arithmetic operations" = các phép toán số học (+, −, ×, ÷). Danh từ đọc /əˈrɪθ.mə.tɪk/.
items.explanationEn: arithmetic /ˌær.ɪθˈmet.ɪk/ (adjective): relating to basic maths with numbers. "Arithmetic operations" are +, −, × and ÷. As a noun it is pronounced /əˈrɪθ.mə.tɪk/.

items.question: Trong câu "Variable assignment is constant.", từ "assignment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Variable assignment is constant.", what does "assignment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: assignment /əˈsaɪn.mənt/ (danh từ): phép gán. "Variable assignment" = phép gán giá trị cho biến (x = 5); nghĩa khác là bài tập được giao.
items.explanationEn: assignment /əˈsaɪn.mənt/ (noun): giving a variable a value. "Variable assignment" means giving a variable a value (x = 5); it can also mean a task given to a student.

items.question: Trong câu "Accessing an array element by index or an object property by key is constant.", từ "access" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Accessing an array element by index or an object property by key is constant.", what does "access" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: access /ˈæk.ses/ (động từ): truy cập. "Access an element" = truy cập (đọc) một phần tử; danh từ "access" = quyền/sự truy cập.
items.explanationEn: access /ˈæk.ses/ (verb): to reach and read. "Access an element" means to reach and read it; the noun "access" means the right or means to reach something.

items.question: Trong câu "Accessing an array element by index or an object property by key is constant.", từ "property" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Accessing an array element by index or an object property by key is constant.", what does "property" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a named value on an object
items.explanation: property /ˈprɒp.ə.ti/ (danh từ): thuộc tính. "Object property" = thuộc tính của object; nghĩa đời thường là tài sản, nhà đất.
items.explanationEn: property /ˈprɒp.ə.ti/ (noun): a named value on an object. An "object property" is a named value on an object; in everyday English property means land or possessions.

items.question: Trong câu "In a loop, the complexity is the number of iterations × the cost of the loop body.", từ "iteration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In a loop, the complexity is the number of iterations × the cost of the loop body.", what does "iteration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: iteration /ˌɪt.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): lần lặp. "Iteration" = một lần lặp; động từ "iterate" (lặp qua). Trong quản lý dự án còn nghĩa là một phiên bản/vòng phát triển.
items.explanationEn: iteration /ˌɪt.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): one pass through a loop. An "iteration" is one pass through a loop; the verb is "iterate". In product work it can also mean a version or cycle.

items.question: Trong câu "Sequential blocks add; nested blocks multiply.", từ "sequential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sequential blocks add; nested blocks multiply.", what does "sequential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (tính từ): tuần tự, nối tiếp. "Sequential" = tuần tự, cái này sau cái kia; danh từ liên quan "sequence" (dãy).
items.explanationEn: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (adjective): one after another. "Sequential" means happening one after another; the related noun is "sequence".

items.question: Trong câu "Sequential blocks add; nested blocks multiply.", từ "nested" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sequential blocks add; nested blocks multiply.", what does "nested" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: nested /ˈnes.tɪd/ (tính từ): lồng nhau. "Nested loops" = vòng lặp lồng nhau; gốc từ "nest" (tổ chim) — cái nằm trong cái khác.
items.explanationEn: nested /ˈnes.tɪd/ (adjective): placed inside another. "Nested loops" are loops inside other loops; it comes from "nest", something sitting inside something else.

items.question: Trong câu "Watch the loop bound, not just the presence of a loop:", từ "presence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Watch the loop bound, not just the presence of a loop:", what does "presence" (noun) mean?
options: sự có mặt, sự tồn tại
items.explanation: presence /ˈprez.əns/ (danh từ): sự có mặt, sự tồn tại. "The presence of X" = việc có X; trái nghĩa "absence". Đừng nhầm với "present" (món quà).
items.explanationEn: presence /ˈprez.əns/ (noun): the fact of being there. "The presence of X" means X is there; the opposite is "absence". Do not confuse it with "present" (a gift).

items.question: Trong câu "A rough budget: modern machines do around 10⁸ simple operations per second.", từ "rough" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A rough budget: modern machines do around 10⁸ simple operations per second.", what does "rough" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: rough /rʌf/ (tính từ): phỏng chừng, ước lượng. "A rough estimate/budget" = ước lượng sơ bộ; nghĩa đen là thô ráp, gồ ghề ("rough surface").
items.explanationEn: rough /rʌf/ (adjective): approximate. "A rough estimate/budget" is an approximate one; literally rough means not smooth, as in "a rough surface".

items.question: Trong câu "A rough budget: modern machines do around 10⁸ simple operations per second.", từ "budget" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A rough budget: modern machines do around 10⁸ simple operations per second.", what does "budget" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: budget /ˈbʌdʒ.ɪt/ (danh từ): mức giới hạn cho phép. "Budget" ở đây = mức giới hạn được phép (số phép toán mỗi giây); nghĩa thường là ngân sách tiền.
items.explanationEn: budget /ˈbʌdʒ.ɪt/ (noun): an allowed limit. Here "budget" means an allowed limit, such as operations per second; usually it means a plan for money.

items.question: Trong câu "With n = 10⁵, O(n log n) is instant, while O(n²) needs ~10¹⁰ operations — far too slow.", từ "instant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With n = 10⁵, O(n log n) is instant, while O(n²) needs ~10¹⁰ operations — far too slow.", what does "instant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: instant /ˈɪn.stənt/ (tính từ): ngay lập tức. "Instant" = tức thì; còn dùng cho đồ ăn pha sẵn ("instant noodles" = mì ăn liền).
items.explanationEn: instant /ˈɪn.stənt/ (adjective): happening at once. "Instant" means happening at once; it also describes quick food, as in "instant noodles".

items.question: Trong câu "Besides O(1), O(n) and O(n²), the expression that shows up most is the logarithm.", từ "besides" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Besides O(1), O(n) and O(n²), the expression that shows up most is the logarithm.", what does "besides" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: besides /bɪˈsaɪdz/ (giới từ): ngoài ... ra. "Besides X" = ngoài X ra; đừng nhầm với "beside" = bên cạnh (vị trí).
items.explanationEn: besides /bɪˈsaɪdz/ (preposition): in addition to. "Besides X" means in addition to X; do not confuse it with "beside", meaning next to.

items.question: Trong câu "In computer science, log means log base 2 by default (and the base does not matter for Big O anyway, since logs of different bases differ only by a constant factor).", từ "by default" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In computer science, log means log base 2 by default (and the base does not matter for Big O anyway, since logs of different bases differ only by a constant factor).", what does "by default" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by default /baɪ dɪˈfɔːlt/ (cụm từ): theo mặc định. "By default" = theo mặc định, khi không nói gì khác; "default value" = giá trị mặc định.
items.explanationEn: by default /baɪ dɪˈfɔːlt/ (phrase): unless stated otherwise. "By default" means what applies when nothing else is specified; a "default value" is the preset value.

items.question: Trong câu "In computer science, log means log base 2 by default (and the base does not matter for Big O anyway, since logs of different bases differ only by a constant factor).", từ "differ" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In computer science, log means log base 2 by default (and the base does not matter for Big O anyway, since logs of different bases differ only by a constant factor).", what does "differ" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differ /ˈdɪf.ər/ (động từ): khác nhau. "Differ by X" = khác nhau một lượng X; "differ from" = khác với.
items.explanationEn: differ /ˈdɪf.ər/ (verb): to be unlike. "Differ by X" means to be different by an amount X; "differ from" means to be unlike something.

items.question: Trong câu "In computer science, log means log base 2 by default (and the base does not matter for Big O anyway, since logs of different bases differ only by a constant factor).", từ "factor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In computer science, log means log base 2 by default (and the base does not matter for Big O anyway, since logs of different bases differ only by a constant factor).", what does "factor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: factor /ˈfæk.tər/ (danh từ): hệ số nhân. "A constant factor" = hệ số nhân không đổi; nghĩa phổ biến khác là yếu tố ("a key factor").
items.explanationEn: factor /ˈfæk.tər/ (noun): a number you multiply by. "A constant factor" is a fixed number you multiply by; it also commonly means a cause, as in "a key factor".

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: the logarithm of a number is roughly how many times you can divide it by 2 before you reach a value ≤ 1.", từ "rule of thumb" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rule of thumb: the logarithm of a number is roughly how many times you can divide it by 2 before you reach a value ≤ 1.", what does "rule of thumb" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (cụm từ): quy tắc kinh nghiệm. "Rule of thumb" = quy tắc kinh nghiệm, đúng trong đa số trường hợp nhưng không tuyệt đối.
items.explanationEn: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (phrase): a practical guideline. A "rule of thumb" is a practical guideline that works most of the time but is not exact.

items.question: Trong câu "So whenever an algorithm halves the remaining work each step, it is O(log n):", từ "halve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "So whenever an algorithm halves the remaining work each step, it is O(log n):", what does "halve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: halve /hɑːv/ (động từ): giảm một nửa. "Halve" = giảm một nửa (đọc giống "have" với âm /ɑː/); danh từ "half", số nhiều "halves".
items.explanationEn: halve /hɑːv/ (verb): to cut in half. "Halve" means to cut into two equal parts; related to "half", plural "halves".

items.question: Trong câu "So whenever an algorithm halves the remaining work each step, it is O(log n):", từ "remaining" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "So whenever an algorithm halves the remaining work each step, it is O(log n):", what does "remaining" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: remaining /rɪˈmeɪ.nɪŋ/ (tính từ): còn lại. "The remaining work" = phần việc còn lại; động từ "remain" = vẫn còn.
items.explanationEn: remaining /rɪˈmeɪ.nɪŋ/ (adjective): still left. "The remaining work" is the work still left; the verb is "remain".

items.question: Trong câu "Search / insert in a balanced binary search tree.", từ "balanced" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Search / insert in a balanced binary search tree.", what does "balanced" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: balanced /ˈbæl.ənst/ (tính từ): cân bằng. "Balanced tree" = cây cân bằng, hai nhánh có độ cao gần như nhau; còn "a balanced diet" = chế độ ăn cân bằng.
items.explanationEn: balanced /ˈbæl.ənst/ (adjective): evenly spread on both sides. A "balanced tree" has branches of nearly equal height; the word also appears in "a balanced diet".

items.question: Trong câu "Insert / extract in a binary heap.", từ "extract" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Insert / extract in a binary heap.", what does "extract" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: extract /ɪkˈstrækt/ (động từ): lấy ra. "Extract" = lấy ra, rút ra; trong heap là lấy phần tử nhỏ/lớn nhất ra ("extract-min"). Danh từ "extract" = chiết xuất.
items.explanationEn: extract /ɪkˈstrækt/ (verb): to take out. "Extract" means to take out; in a heap it removes the top element ("extract-min"). The noun can mean a concentrated substance.

items.question: Trong câu "Insert / extract in a binary heap.", từ "heap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Insert / extract in a binary heap.", what does "heap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: heap /hiːp/ (danh từ): đống (cấu trúc dữ liệu). "Binary heap" = đống nhị phân, cây dùng cho hàng đợi ưu tiên; nghĩa đời thường là một đống lộn xộn.
items.explanationEn: heap /hiːp/ (noun): a priority tree structure. A "binary heap" is a tree used for priority queues; in everyday English a heap is an untidy pile.

items.question: Trong câu "Merge sort: the array is split in half log n times, and each level merges n elements.", từ "split" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Merge sort: the array is split in half log n times, and each level merges n elements.", what does "split" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: split /splɪt/ (động từ): chia tách. "Split in half" = chia đôi; dạng quá khứ và phân từ vẫn là "split".
items.explanationEn: split /splɪt/ (verb): to divide into parts. "Split in half" means to divide into two parts; the past forms are also "split".

items.question: Trong câu "Log in space — recursion that halves its input (e.g. recursive binary search) keeps only log n frames on the call stack, so it uses O(log n) space.", từ "recursion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Log in space — recursion that halves its input (e.g. recursive binary search) keeps only log n frames on the call stack, so it uses O(log n) space.", what does "recursion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: recursion /rɪˈkɜː.ʒən/ (danh từ): đệ quy. "Recursion" = đệ quy; tính từ "recursive", động từ "recurse".
items.explanationEn: recursion /rɪˈkɜː.ʒən/ (noun): a function calling itself. "Recursion" is when a function calls itself; the adjective is "recursive" and the verb is "recurse".

items.question: Trong câu "O(2ⁿ) — each call branches into two calls:", từ "branch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "O(2ⁿ) — each call branches into two calls:", what does "branch" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: branch /brɑːntʃ/ (động từ): tách nhánh, rẽ ra. "Branch into two" = rẽ thành hai nhánh; trong Git "branch" còn là nhánh mã nguồn.
items.explanationEn: branch /brɑːntʃ/ (verb): to split into several paths. "Branch into two" means to split into two paths; in Git a branch is a separate line of code.

items.question: Trong câu "fib(2) is computed twice already; by fib(40) there are hundreds of millions of calls.", từ "compute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "fib(2) is computed twice already; by fib(40) there are hundreds of millions of calls.", what does "compute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: compute /kəmˈpjuːt/ (động từ): tính toán. "Compute" = tính toán; danh từ "computation", cũng là gốc của "computer".
items.explanationEn: compute /kəmˈpjuːt/ (verb): to calculate. "Compute" means to calculate; the noun is "computation", and it is the root of "computer".

items.question: Trong câu "So far we have measured time.", từ "so far" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "So far we have measured time.", what does "so far" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: so far /səʊ ˈfɑːr/ (cụm từ): cho đến nay. "So far" = cho đến giờ, thường đi với thì hiện tại hoàn thành ("we have measured").
items.explanationEn: so far /səʊ ˈfɑːr/ (phrase): up to now. "So far" means up to now and usually goes with the present perfect ("we have measured").

items.question: Trong câu "Auxiliary space complexity is the space the algorithm allocates not counting the input itself.", từ "auxiliary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Auxiliary space complexity is the space the algorithm allocates not counting the input itself.", what does "auxiliary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: auxiliary /ɔːɡˈzɪl.i.ər.i/ (tính từ): phụ, bổ trợ. "Auxiliary space" = bộ nhớ phụ, không tính input; "auxiliary verb" = trợ động từ.
items.explanationEn: auxiliary /ɔːɡˈzɪl.i.ər.i/ (adjective): extra, supporting. "Auxiliary space" is the extra memory beyond the input; the word also appears in "auxiliary verb".

items.question: Trong câu "Auxiliary space complexity is the space the algorithm allocates not counting the input itself.", từ "allocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Auxiliary space complexity is the space the algorithm allocates not counting the input itself.", what does "allocate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (động từ): cấp phát. "Allocate memory" = cấp phát bộ nhớ; trái nghĩa "free/deallocate". Nghĩa chung: phân bổ (ngân sách, thời gian).
items.explanationEn: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (verb): to set aside for use. "Allocate memory" means to set it aside for use; the opposite is "free" or "deallocate". Generally it means to distribute resources.

items.question: Trong câu "Also count the call stack: each pending recursive call holds a stack frame, so recursion depth d costs O(d) space.", từ "pending" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Also count the call stack: each pending recursive call holds a stack frame, so recursion depth d costs O(d) space.", what does "pending" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pending /ˈpen.dɪŋ/ (tính từ): đang chờ xử lý. "Pending" = đang chờ, chưa xong; hay gặp: "pending request", "pending approval".
items.explanationEn: pending /ˈpen.dɪŋ/ (adjective): waiting to finish. "Pending" means waiting to be finished; common in "pending request" and "pending approval".

items.question: Trong câu "Also count the call stack: each pending recursive call holds a stack frame, so recursion depth d costs O(d) space.", từ "depth" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Also count the call stack: each pending recursive call holds a stack frame, so recursion depth d costs O(d) space.", what does "depth" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: depth /depθ/ (danh từ): độ sâu. "Recursion depth" = độ sâu đệ quy (số lời gọi chồng lên nhau); tính từ "deep".
items.explanationEn: depth /depθ/ (noun): how deep something goes. "Recursion depth" is how many calls are stacked at once; the adjective is "deep".

items.question: Trong câu "O(1) space — only a fixed number of variables, however long the array is:", từ "fixed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "O(1) space — only a fixed number of variables, however long the array is:", what does "fixed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fixed /fɪkst/ (tính từ): cố định. "A fixed number" = một số lượng cố định; nghĩa khác của "fixed" là đã được sửa ("the bug is fixed").
items.explanationEn: fixed /fɪkst/ (adjective): not changing. "A fixed number" is one that does not change; "fixed" can also mean repaired, as in "the bug is fixed".

items.question: Trong câu "The same algorithm can behave differently on different inputs.", từ "behave" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same algorithm can behave differently on different inputs.", what does "behave" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: behave /bɪˈheɪv/ (động từ): hoạt động, vận hành. "Behave differently" = hoạt động khác nhau; danh từ "behaviour/behavior". Với trẻ con: "behave!" = ngoan nào.
items.explanationEn: behave /bɪˈheɪv/ (verb): to act or perform. "Behave differently" means to act or perform differently; the noun is "behaviour/behavior". To a child, "behave!" means be polite.

items.question: Trong câu "Target is last or absent", từ "absent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Target is last or absent", what does "absent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: absent /ˈæb.sənt/ (tính từ): không có mặt. "Absent" = không có mặt, không tồn tại; "absent-minded" = đãng trí; danh từ "absence".
items.explanationEn: absent /ˈæb.sənt/ (adjective): not present. "Absent" means not present; "absent-minded" means forgetful, and the noun is "absence".

items.question: Trong câu "Unless told otherwise, quote the worst case — it is the guarantee.", từ "guarantee" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Unless told otherwise, quote the worst case — it is the guarantee.", what does "guarantee" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (danh từ): sự bảo đảm. "It is the guarantee" = đó là sự bảo đảm (thuật toán không bao giờ tệ hơn); nghĩa thương mại là phiếu bảo hành.
items.explanationEn: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (noun): a certain promise. "It is the guarantee" means the algorithm will never do worse; commercially a guarantee can be a product warranty.

items.question: Trong câu "Amortized cost averages over a sequence of operations.", từ "amortized" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Amortized cost averages over a sequence of operations.", what does "amortized" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: amortized /ˈæm.ə.taɪzd/ (tính từ): bình quân theo chuỗi. "Amortized O(1)" = trung bình O(1) khi xét cả chuỗi thao tác; trong kế toán amortize = khấu hao dần.
items.explanationEn: amortized /ˈæm.ə.taɪzd/ (adjective): averaged over many operations. "Amortized O(1)" means O(1) on average over many operations; in accounting, amortize means to write off gradually.

items.question: Trong câu "Amortized cost averages over a sequence of operations.", từ "sequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Amortized cost averages over a sequence of operations.", what does "sequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sequence /ˈsiː.kwəns/ (danh từ): chuỗi, dãy. "A sequence of operations" = một chuỗi thao tác theo thứ tự; tính từ "sequential".
items.explanationEn: sequence /ˈsiː.kwəns/ (noun): a series in order. "A sequence of operations" is a series of them in order; the adjective is "sequential".

items.question: Trong câu "arr.push() is occasionally O(n) when the underlying storage is resized, but amortized O(1) over many pushes.", từ "occasionally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "arr.push() is occasionally O(n) when the underlying storage is resized, but amortized O(1) over many pushes.", what does "occasionally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: occasionally /əˈkeɪ.ʒən.əl.i/ (trạng từ): thỉnh thoảng. "Occasionally" = thỉnh thoảng, hiếm khi xảy ra; tính từ "occasional".
items.explanationEn: occasionally /əˈkeɪ.ʒən.əl.i/ (adverb): now and then. "Occasionally" means now and then, not often; the adjective is "occasional".

items.question: Trong câu "arr.push() is occasionally O(n) when the underlying storage is resized, but amortized O(1) over many pushes.", từ "underlying" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "arr.push() is occasionally O(n) when the underlying storage is resized, but amortized O(1) over many pushes.", what does "underlying" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: underlying /ˌʌn.dəˈlaɪ.ɪŋ/ (tính từ): nằm bên dưới. "Underlying storage" = vùng lưu trữ bên dưới (mà mảng dựa vào); "underlying cause" = nguyên nhân gốc.
items.explanationEn: underlying /ˌʌn.dəˈlaɪ.ɪŋ/ (adjective): lying beneath. "Underlying storage" is the memory beneath the array; "underlying cause" means the root cause.

items.question: Trong câu "Hidden loops are the most common analysis mistake.", từ "hidden" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hidden loops are the most common analysis mistake.", what does "hidden" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hidden /ˈhɪd.ən/ (tính từ): ẩn, không lộ ra. "Hidden loops" = vòng lặp ẩn bên trong hàm có sẵn; động từ gốc "hide".
items.explanationEn: hidden /ˈhɪd.ən/ (adjective): not easy to see. "Hidden loops" are loops concealed inside built-in methods; the base verb is "hide".

items.question: Trong câu "Built-ins with a hidden O(n): includes, indexOf, slice, concat, spread [...arr], shift/unshift, Object.keys, and repeated string concatenation in a loop.", từ "concatenation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Built-ins with a hidden O(n): includes, indexOf, slice, concat, spread [...arr], shift/unshift, Object.keys, and repeated string concatenation in a loop.", what does "concatenation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: concatenation /kənˌkæt.əˈneɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự nối chuỗi. "String concatenation" = nối chuỗi; động từ "concatenate", viết tắt trong JS là "concat".
items.explanationEn: concatenation /kənˌkæt.əˈneɪ.ʃən/ (noun): joining strings end to end. "String concatenation" means joining strings end to end; the verb is "concatenate", shortened to "concat" in JS.

items.question: Trong câu "Big O describes growth rate as input grows, not exact time; it depends on the algorithm, not the hardware.", từ "exact" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Big O describes growth rate as input grows, not exact time; it depends on the algorithm, not the hardware.", what does "exact" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: exact /ɪɡˈzækt/ (tính từ): chính xác. "Exact time" = thời gian chính xác; trạng từ "exactly".
items.explanationEn: exact /ɪɡˈzækt/ (adjective): precise. "Exact time" means the precise time; the adverb is "exactly".

items.question: Trong câu "State both time and space; space means auxiliary space and includes the recursion call stack.", từ "state" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "State both time and space; space means auxiliary space and includes the recursion call stack.", what does "state" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: state /steɪt/ (động từ): nêu rõ, phát biểu. "State" (động từ) = nêu rõ; danh từ "state" = trạng thái hoặc bang (tiểu bang).
items.explanationEn: state /steɪt/ (verb): to say clearly. "State" (verb) means to say clearly; the noun can mean a condition or a region of a country.

items.question: Trong câu "Timers are unreliable for comparing algorithms, so we count operations and look at the trend.", từ "unreliable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Timers are unreliable for comparing algorithms, so we count operations and look at the trend.", what does "unreliable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unreliable /ˌʌn.rɪˈlaɪ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): không đáng tin cậy. "Unreliable" = không đáng tin cậy; trái nghĩa "reliable", danh từ "reliability".
items.explanationEn: unreliable /ˌʌn.rɪˈlaɪ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): not dependable. "Unreliable" means not dependable; the opposite is "reliable" and the noun is "reliability".

items.question: Trong câu "An algorithm is O(f(n)) if its operations are eventually bounded by c · f(n).", từ "bound" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An algorithm is O(f(n)) if its operations are eventually bounded by c · f(n).", what does "bound" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bound /baʊnd/ (động từ): bị chặn (giới hạn). "Be bounded by X" = bị chặn bởi X, không vượt quá X; danh từ "bound" = cận.
items.explanationEn: bound /baʊnd/ (verb): to be limited by. "Be bounded by X" means never exceeding X; the noun "bound" means a limit.

items.question: Trong câu "Simplify by removing constants and lower-order terms; analyse loops as iterations × body cost.", từ "simplify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Simplify by removing constants and lower-order terms; analyse loops as iterations × body cost.", what does "simplify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: simplify /ˈsɪm.plɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): rút gọn, đơn giản hóa. "Simplify an expression" = rút gọn biểu thức; danh từ "simplification".
items.explanationEn: simplify /ˈsɪm.plɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to make simpler. "Simplify an expression" means to reduce it to a simpler form; the noun is "simplification".

items.question: Trong câu "Quote the worst case unless asked; mention amortized cost for dynamic array push.", từ "mention" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quote the worst case unless asked; mention amortized cost for dynamic array push.", what does "mention" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mention /ˈmen.ʃən/ (động từ): nhắc đến. "Mention X" = nhắc đến X (không cần "about"); "as mentioned above" = như đã nói ở trên.
items.explanationEn: mention /ˈmen.ʃən/ (verb): to refer to briefly. "Mention X" means to refer to it briefly (no "about"); "as mentioned above" is a common phrase.
